source_aliases.use: Primary narrative for daily-bar timing, left/right structural paths, DD low-line versus descending-high-line roles, strict structural invalidation, and the incomplete 1B/2B quality concept.
Corroborating narrative that separates a directional source from timing geometry and names DD/trend-line details as unresolved.
Corroborating inventory of known, inferred, and black-box stages; used only for provenance and boundary checks.

source_supported_behaviors.behavior: Use completed daily K-bars as the operating cadence for the described structure reading.
Treat a low-point extension as the left-side target path and a descending-high extension break as the alternate right-side confirmation path.
Give the left-side path priority over the right-side path when both appear available.
Represent a strict structural failure beyond the DD structure as an invalidation state.
Recognize that 2B is described as higher quality than 1B and that K-bar context is holistic, while the source does not provide a complete deterministic definition.
The source material itself marks several rule details as unresolved or subject to later calibration; it does not license an authenticity claim.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Interpret bare-K as generic completed OHLC bars, without selecting an instrument or an option contract.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: The required v0 scope excludes option inputs and execution while retaining the source's K-bar geometry at a research level.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: The narrative discusses timing on a particular chart context rather than a generic instrument-free OHLC interface.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: This broadens the interface while intentionally reducing fidelity to any original chart or contract convention.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Bind the same geometry to an independently recovered, source-authorized chart definition and compare traces without claiming equivalence.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Define a pivot with strict three-bar local extrema and use the latest two qualifying pivots.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: A causal finite rule is necessary to make line construction auditable.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: The source names extrema and trend lines but does not define an algorithmic pivot detector, tie policy, or anchor-selection rule.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: Candidate timing can change materially versus hand-drawn or differently anchored lines.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Replace with a recovered anchor annotation set or a source-authorized pivot definition and replay the synthetic fixtures.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Project each structural line as a straight line through its two selected pivots.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: It is the smallest deterministic interpretation of an extremum extension.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: No line-fitting, touch-count, tolerance, or projection convention is specified.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: Boundary values and therefore touch/break classifications are sensitive to this choice.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Use a recovered multi-touch or tolerance-based line definition and retain the same trace schema.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Require a bullish close for a long touch and a bearish close for a short mirrored touch.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: The source refers to a reversal/spike context but does not formalize its bar shape.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: No exact reversal-bar predicate is given.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: This can exclude or admit edge cases near the structural line.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Leave the touch ungated or substitute a recovered bar-context classifier, then compare fixture traces.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Use a completed close beyond the projected structural line as invalidation, with no added distance buffer.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: The source describes a strict stop beyond structure, but the v0 contract forbids tick, price, and execution parameters.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: The exact buffer and its evaluation convention are unspecified for this bare-K scope.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: This is stricter or looser than any unrecovered buffered convention depending on the bar path.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Add an explicitly sourced, unit-free structural buffer only after its definition is recovered.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Mirror the long geometry to emit a provisional short structural-reversal label.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: The source acknowledges two directional orientations, while v0 must state direction semantics without using an external directional input.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: The exact bearish mirror, its anchors, and its relationship to the original process are not defined.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: Short classifications have lower fidelity confidence than the explicitly described long/bottom geometry.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Disable short output until a separately sourced bearish decision chain is recovered.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Do not implement 1B/2B or a holistic K-bar-strength score as a v0 gate.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: A deterministic threshold would invent the unresolved black-box behavior; abstention is more honest than fitting one.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: The source expressly lacks the complete 1B/2B and holistic-quality definition.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: v0 is a deliberately incomplete structural screen and may be less selective than the intended process.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Introduce a separately versioned quality gate only with recovered labels or a source-authorized deterministic specification.

provisional_assumptions.behavior: Apply invalidation before positive states, then conflicts, then left candidate before right confirmation.
provisional_assumptions.rationale: The left-path preference is sourced; the full ordering is needed to make simultaneous synthetic cases deterministic.
provisional_assumptions.source_gap: The complete ordering for all simultaneous states is not specified.
provisional_assumptions.expected_impact: Only simultaneous or degenerate geometries are affected.
provisional_assumptions.testable_alternative: Return an abstention for every simultaneous positive/negative state and compare trace completeness.

fidelity_limitations: No 1B/2B, holistic quality score, original anchors, tolerance, buffer, or chart convention has been recovered.
The short branch is provisional and is not evidence of original directional symmetry.
No market, option, premium, execution, or performance claim is present.
